newsitem.title: USA: Mideast tension makes World Bank want to help more.
newsitem.headline: Mideast tension makes World Bank want to help more.

text.p: The latest tension in the Middle East has only encouraged the World Bank to try harder to help, Bank President James Wolfensohn said on Thursday.
"Far from turning us off, we are doing our very best to help," he told reporters, adding that the Bank's efforts had already created 20,000 jobs in the West Bank and Gaza.
"What we are going to do is to ensure that in the territories that we can try and provide some sense of hope," he said.

"We are intimately involved in the economic plans. We are trying very hard to get joint economic activities going between the Israelis and the Palestinians. Every chance we get we are trying to build those links."
